defects.claim: Description: 'Cross the far ankle over the near one' — ankles should cross (one ankle in front of/side of other). Current hipAbductL=10 (slight adduction, left ankle moves toward center) + hipAbductR=-10 (abduction, right ankle moves outward). PR-v5 comment (line 619 of poses-data.js) claims 'right leg crosses behind left' but under CORRECTED convention 'hipAbduct + = adduction (inward/cross), - = abduction (outward/spread)', hipAbductR=-10 ABDUCTS the right leg (outward), NOT crossing. PR-v5 used the OLD INVERTED convention. Result: leftAnkle x=0.194, rightAnkle x=0.412 (both on right side, right ankle further right, ankles SPREADING apart, NOT crossed).
defects.evidence: geometry.json: leftAnkle x=0.194, rightAnkle x=0.412 — both on figure's right side, rightAnkle FURTHER right (legs spreading apart, not crossing).

failing_tests.assertion: rightAnkle.x < leftAnkle.x (right ankle crossed over left to figure's left side)
failing_tests.actual: rightAnkle x=0.412 > leftAnkle x=0.194 (both on right side, spreading apart)

regression_risk: low — single-field hipAbduct sign flip; verified ankles cross correctly, both feet remain planted, no new anomalies.
rationale: MAJOR fix: hipAbductR -10→+20 (FLIP from abduction to adduction per CORRECTED convention 'hipAbduct + = adduction/inward, - = abduction/outward'). Verified via verify-patch.js: rightAnkle x 0.412→-0.027 (crosses to LEFT of body center ✓), leftAnkle x=0.194 (stays on right side), so right ankle is now LEFT of left ankle = CROSSED ✓.
